summary: Arbitration appointment dispute; clause requiring bilateral discussions under Article 21.1; limitation issue post-COVID extensions; waiver of time bar; unilateral arbitration invocation; Contract No. 78953/SMG/GS/WE-4 breach; encashment of warranty bond; liquidated damages recovery; delay in supply; appointment of sole arbitrator directed.
final_judgment: Arbitrator directed to be appointed by Ministry of Defence within 30 days; petition allowed; failure to appoint shall result in Chief Justice nominating arbitrator.
